text_block_list.name: Tani no Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
—Anguish... A bizarre prison residing 
within the labyrinth of life... Can I, 
imprisoned like the Count of Monte Cristo, 
ever hope to escape—?

text_block_list.name: Tani no Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
My destiny to intoxicate the masses... My 
aesthetic... Yet what element is needed to 
ensnare even more...? Tch, what is it? 
Answer me, abyss of my—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, what's with the long face? The 
show's about to start, y'know!

Today we were attending a theatrical play 
for an academy event. Tanino Gimlet and 
the others seemed quite lively...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
If brooding won't solve it, why not 
immerse yourself in another world for a 
change desu wa? I'm sure it'll make for a 
wonderful change of pace!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
That's right! A grand adventure is about 
to unfold right before our eyes. You'd be 
losing out if you didn't enjoy it!

text_block_list.name: Tani no Gimlet
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph.

text_block_list.name: Tani no Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Kuku, hahahaha! I see, the stage! A 
dizzying illusion, yet reality! Indeed, it 
was just what I needed to shift my mood.

text_block_list.name: Tani no Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Particularly the wailing in the middle of 
the tale... that was exquisite! The sight 
of being crushed by despair moves one to 
tears!

text_block_list.name: Tani no Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
It is precisely because one hits rock 
bottom in agony that a faint glimmer of 
hope becomes a path of light illuminating 
the protagonist... Ahh! That was the 
message I needed right now!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yes, yes! That development was thrilling 
desu wa! The tragedy blended so well with 
the historical setting; it was truly a 
well-crafted script.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
In an era of turmoil, those who staked 
everything seeking revolution, those who 
fell... People in circumstances just like 
the protagonists truly existed. That's why 
it was so deeply moving desu wa.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Also, the way the music shifted alongside 
the emotional changes gave me goosebumps. 
Didn't it?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Why the hell are you asking me...? Well, I 
gotta admit, it was pretty well done.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Increasing the brass section to match the 
mood with the direction of the plot... 
That was good reference material.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Right! And the way they broke into dance 
fit so perfectly with expressing a zest 
for life~♪

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Oi, don't drag me into it! If you wanna 
reenact it, do it yourself!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Exactly, dance! That was such a 
thrilling spectacle. I had a hard time 
keeping myself from dancing right there in 
the audience!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Indeed... The footsteps... from the tap. 
The vibrations... reached me.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Whoops, sorry! But I couldn't help it! 
Everyone dancing! Singing! Hyped up! It 
was an ending worthy of doing just that!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... Each character... lived their 
life... to the fullest on stage. I felt 
that.

text_block_list.name: Tani no Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Even though we watched the exact same 
thing, to think such completely different 
impressions could emerge...

text_block_list.name: Tani no Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore, to be so captivated... 
endlessly intoxicated...

text_block_list.name: Tani no Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
The intoxicating elements differ... But 
precisely because of that! It can 
intoxicate the multitudes...! This is 
it!!!!

text_block_list.name: Tani no Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Intoxicating the masses through theater, 
spreading my aesthetics—those who resonate 
will surely make their way to the 
battlefield to witness the essence of that 
aesthetic!!

text_block_list.name: Tani no Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Yes, to confirm the message I have sent... 
And there, I shall deliver the final 
intoxicating blow!!

text_block_list.name: Tani no Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
To convey a message, a narrative form 
would be best... In other words, a script.

text_block_list.name: Tani no Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Kuku... O God of Wine! You have finally 
smiled upon me! I have received your 
divine revelation loud and clear!

...As the students were heading home, I 
spotted Tanino Gimlet laughing loudly all 
by herself. What should I do...?

text_block_list.name: Tani no Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Oh! You who happen to be present at this 
very moment, are you too summoned by 
destiny to witness the birth of 
creation...?!

text_block_list.name: Tani no Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Well, you need not comprehend it just yet. 
But brace yourself! For you shall bear 
witness!

text_block_list.name: Tani no Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
To the sweet yet gruesome 'Tragedy of 
Farewell'—and the sight of people drunk 
upon its potent elixir!

text_block_list.name: Tani no Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Kuku... Hahaha! Hahahaha!!

It would be rude to pour cold water on her 
mood, so I should just leave quietly... or 
so I thought.

text_block_list.name: Tani no Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Dammit! I cannot suppress this surging 
fervor! I must write it down this instant, 
right this second!!

text_block_list.name: Tani no Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Out of the way, fence that dares obstruct 
my path!
(—CRASH!!)

text_block_list.name: Tani no Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
...Oops, my bad. After destruction comes 
rebirth. First, I must repair this...
